comments.author: Recoil42
comments.body:
Made primarily with Codex, Suno, Tripo, and ChatGPT Image 2. 

Picking a random fun detail to share: Everyone storefront was generated with ChatGPT Image 2 via Codex, which was told to generate dozens of different unique store concepts, generate them, and compile them into one large texture atlases. Can't recommend this workflow enough — using Codex's app-server means you can even do the generation with massive parallelism: 

https://preview.redd.it/x60xseiiwkyg1.jpeg?width=3072&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=a3a207a824cdbefc6d5b825f3ed482e2651a2cc8

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body:
